type Scores = { [key: string]: number | string; [key: number]: number };
function setScore(scores: Scores, key: string | number, score: number) {
  scores[key] = score;
  scores[key] += 2;
  scores[key]++;
  return scores[key];
}
function setSharedIndex(obj: { [key: number]: number } | { [key: number]: string }, key: number) {
  obj[key] = 'updated';
  return obj[key];
}
function updateAccessor(obj: { get label(): string; set label(value: string | number); [key: number]: number }, key: 'label' | number) {
  obj[key] = 4;
  return obj[key]++;
}
function setGeneric<K extends string | number>(obj: Scores, key: K, score: number) {
  obj[key] = score;
}
const scores: Scores = { 0: 10 };
console.log(setScore(scores, 0, 20), setSharedIndex({ 0: '' }, 0));
const accessors = {
  current: 0,
  0: 1,
  get label(): string { return String(this.current); },
  set label(value: string | number) { this.current = Number(value); }
};
console.log(updateAccessor(accessors, 'label'), accessors.label);
setGeneric(scores, 'final', 30);
console.log(scores.final);
